title: Discover the Spatial Preview framework
description: Check out how the new Spatial Preview framework brings content from your Mac directly into visionOS. Discover how to build dynamic workflows with live-syncing and bidirectional editing across both platforms. Learn about the SpatialPreview API, device discovery, 2D and 3D session integration, and new Quick Look capabilities to elevate your Mac apps spatially.
